properties.description_en: Click to edit the images used for each face of the shape.

properties.description_en: The 3D shape primitive to use. Note not all shapes use all six faces.

properties.description_en: Where the object origin is on the Z axis.
properties.description_zh: 物体位于 Z 轴上的位置。

properties.description_en: Choose whether the object is visible when the layout starts.
properties.description_zh: 在场景开始时，对象是否可见。

properties.description_en: Automatically hides faces that are pointing away from the camera.

properties.description_en: Optionally choose another object to use as the image for each face of the shape. An instance of the object must be in the same layout.
properties.description_zh: 可选。允许选择一个对象作为每个朝面的图像。注意，此对象的实例必须放置在相同的场景中。
